line2: Contemporary Fremennik sails are simply white, but perhaps those ancient Fremennik's splashed out on something akin to traditional Viking ships back in Britain.
Not that they'd have known each other.
I’m Sam, the musician for the channel, and I’ve spent the last two and a half years rearranging many of my favourite songs to fit the Old School RuneScape aesthetic.
Rather than swapping instruments on pre-existing MIDI files, I record everything in Logic Pro X with my MIDI keyboard...
...while trying to emulate the decisions commonly made by RuneScape’s composers.
I’m Ren or Micromole, I excessively research fonts, recreate album covers in OSRS style and make unreasonable musical requests of Sam.
I'm Lilly, or LillySad! I mostly work on art and occasionally throw dumb lyrics and unrealistic song ideas at Sam in the hopes that some stick!
